comment: Pre-trained models known to xnn. One ModelCard per entry (src/xnn/common/models/hub/card.py). Add a model by uploading its portable directory (xnn models pack) to Zenodo and adding an entry with its doi.

models.name: xnn-mace-argon
models.description: MACE (2 layers, 32 channels, 6 A cutoff) trained on the argon_md liquid-argon set; the model of the MDI deployment examples
models.notes: Trained with forces weighted 100x over energies: accurate forces (MAE ~2 meV/A), absolute energies scatter by ~15 meV/atom. Pending Zenodo upload: the card names no DOI yet, so it loads only where it is cached.
